data.name: Block-Lite
data.detailed_description:
Mo' Guys N' Guns Update is here!

  • 10 NEW GUNS AND 10 NEW GUYS TO UNLOCK AND PLAY WITH!

  • Tons of QOL improvements

  • Fresh coat of paint to the game!

  • New music tracks!

  • New unlock system!

  • Many more secrets and tweaks to find out!

(FOR FULL RELEASE NOTES PLEASE SEE BOTTOM OF DESCRIPTION)

Block-Lite is a lightweight, pick-up-and-play roguelite built for pure fun. Simple art, groovy tunes, and chaotic gameplay come together in a game that’s easy to learn but hard to put down.

  • More than 20 characters & weapons – Play and unlock 20+ unique characters and distinct weapons. Mix and match for over 100+ combinations that guarantee every run feels fresh and unique.

  • Challenging enemies & bosses – Test your skill across 50 escalating waves of challenging enemies and bosses. Push your limits with optional challenges for extra rewards, and if you are up for it, push beyond wave 50 to loop and experience an even greater challenge.

  • Weapon Evolutions – Power up your gear mid-run! Upgrade your weapons to unlock powerful new forms that dramatically ramp up your damage and transform your playstyle.

  • Master the Meta: Earn trophies and achievements for completing runs with every character and weapon. Show off your mastery!

  • Simple but polished – Everything you need, nothing you don’t. Simple Roguelite fun!

  • Secrets to uncover - Uncover easter eggs and hidden features!

Whether you’ve got 10 minutes or a whole afternoon, Block-Lite is designed to be fun in short bursts or long marathons.

V1.3 Release Notes:

  • 10 New Characters and Weapons added

  • New token unlock system, each run grants one unlock token, you can now pick what you want to unlock. Previous unlocks carry over. One unlock token is granted to every player as part of the update

  • New weapon specialties added. Each character now has mild bonuses for specific weapons

  • Volume now has 0, 25, 50, 75, and 100 instead of just 0, 50, 100. Volume setting also now saves

  • Upgraded Katana now has larger projectile that travels further

  • Knife, Katana, and Riot Shield now have new animations that slightly change their attack (overall buff)

  • Wave modifiers now grant bonus XP and Cash to guarantee a reward

  • Fixed boss wave ending prematurely

  • Fixed wave ending prematurely

  • Adjusted enemy spawns to improve pacing and fairness

  • Reworked Rhomboid and Star enemy AI

  • Reworked all Boss AI (smarter and more unique)

  • Reworked difficulty scaling, now more heavily influenced by damage stat

  • Reduced chance of final wave enemy being slow to appear

  • Removed Holiday rush and Holiday themed easter egg

  • New menu and boss theme

  • Revamped audio levels and general effects

  • Reworked several animations to look cleaner

  • Cleaned up several sprites

  • Fixed visual and performance issues with crit and bonus damage modifiers

  • Reworked Turret and Minion AI to have smarter path finding and aim

  • Increased player dash distance and buffed dash bash upgrade

  • Fixed issue where too many enemies could spawn crashing the game

  • Other minor stability fixes

❤️ Additional Credits/Info ❤️

Block-Lite was made entirely within TurboWarp and many of the sounds in game are from the TurboWarp engine, I would like to give credit to them and a big thanks for putting together such a fun and flexible game engine.

I also would like to thank many of my friends who tested this game for bugs and gave gameplay feedback, it would not be as polished with them.

To report bugs please use one of the following:

  • Email grimgstudios@gmail.com

  • Block-Lite Steam community page

data.short_description: Block-Lite is a simple, fast-paced roguelite! Choose your character, grab a weapon, and fight through wave after wave of enemies until you become unstoppable.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 3000 or better)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs on basically anything
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs on basically anything
